tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find tracked models by name or category. Returns ids, names and typical used prices.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Current typical used price, fair range, lowest listing, new price, 7/30-day change and 90-day low for one model.

tools.name: check_price
tools.description: Is this asking price a good deal? Compares a USD price (including shipping) with the current used market for the model.

tools.name: list_category
tools.description: Current used prices for every tracked model in a category.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Tracked categories and how many models each has.

tools.name: market_movers
tools.description: Biggest 7-day used price drops and rises.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily typical used price and fair range for a model. Free: last 30 days; with an Orbit API key: up to 365 days.
